definition: The group of words for the standing a style gives each variant a slot may take: canonical, permitted, atypical or forbidden.
basis: schema/glossary-term.schema.json, the description of `family`, which lists the families in the order the Glossary page shows them: "`variant-status` holds the standing a style gives each variant a slot may take", and "Each value is bound by exactly one `family-<value>` record, whose term heads the group on the page."
